record.oneLiner: A wide-mouthed sauropod with over 500 teeth.
record.description: Nigersaurus was a small rebbachisaurid sauropod of mid-Cretaceous Niger, about 9 m long with a short neck and a bizarre, highly specialised skull. Its wide, straight-edged muzzle held more than 500 teeth, replaced roughly every two weeks, for cropping ground-level plants.

notableFacts.text: Its wide muzzle held over 500 teeth, replaced about every 14 days.
Had an extremely lightweight, specialised skull for ground-level grazing.
